messages:
sam (support): Heads-up: AcmeCorp opened a ticket asking for streaming completions that can emit function/tool calls and structured output mid-stream. They want partial structured frames, resume-after-reconnect, and a schema contract so their downstream processors can consume incrementally.

mira (sales): They said it's blocking a pilot. Eager to know if this is 'possible with current API + docs' or if we need a feature. 

sam (support): Quote from ticket: 'We need server-sent events that include both delta text and discrete structured frames (JSON records) and an explicit fn_call frame when the model requests an external tool. The client must be able to reconnect and pick up without reprocessing already-applied events.'

elaine (PM): Thanks — can we list acceptance criteria and options? My initial thoughts: 1) streaming frames with type field (delta/text, structured, fncall), 2) resume token in stream checkpoint, 3) server-side schema validation and optional per-frame signatures, 4) clear fallback (non-streaming batch) when not supported. Priority from sales: P1 for enterprise pilot.

raj (eng): Implementation questions: do we expect function calls to be emitted as a single "fn_call" frame with full args, or can args be chunked across text frames? Chunking makes replay/resume harder. Prefer single atomic fn_call frame. Also need to consider KV cache/beam alignment for partial outputs — will affect latency.

jess (eng-ml): Also: structured frames must be stable wrt tokenizer boundaries if they embed text. For JSON frames we should base64-encode binary/blobs or send as separate structured payload. Example stream lines (proto):

```
{ "seq": 1, "type": "delta", "text": "Generating summary..." }
{ "seq": 2, "type": "structured", "schema": "order.v1", "payload": {"order_id": 1234} }
{ "seq": 3, "type": "fn_call", "name": "createOrder", "args": {"items": [ ... ]} }
{ "seq": 4, "type": "delta", "text": "Done." }
```

elaine (PM): Good example. Need to define resume semantics: seq-based checkpoint in stream (last-acked seq) + idempotency guarantees for fn_call. For launch criteria I'd propose: - Pilot docs & sample client + SDK helper - Schema validation hooks in console - End-to-end test with reconnect/resume scenario - Backwards compatibility with existing streaming clients

raj (eng): Rough effort: core runtime changes to emit typed frames ~2-3 sprints (eng-runtime), client SDK changes ~1 sprint, console/schema work ~1 sprint. Risk: model-side behavior (model requesting tool mid-stream) needs coordinator changes for token emission ordering.

mira (sales): Timing matters — customer expects pilot in 8 weeks. They can sign MSA if we commit to roadmap.

sam (support): Also asked about rate limits/backpressure — they want advisory headers for clients to slow down or buffer, and a suggested reconnection backoff.

jess (eng-ml): Note: function call payloads may be large. We should support streaming fn_call args (chunked) but mark fn_call as 'incomplete' until final chunk; however that complicates resume. Option A: only allow atomic fn_call frames (preferred). Option B: allow chunking with chunk IDs and reassembly. Document tradeoffs.

elaine (PM): Decision needed: atomic fn_call frames only for pilot (lower complexity). We'll add chunking as a follow-up. Acceptance tests: reconnect+resume no duplicate fn_call side effects, schema conformance, perf within X% of current streaming latency.

raj (eng): I'll scope tech design doc. Can engineering commit to pilot in 8 weeks if we keep atomic fn_calls?

ci-bot: Related issue created: #INF-4892 streaming-fncall-incremental-schema 

elaine (PM): Next steps: 1) raj and jess to write short design doc (linked in thread) by EOD Wed, 2) sam to prioritize any open tickets and collate sample customer payloads, 3) mira to confirm contract timeline with AcmeCorp. I'll add to roadmap as 'pilot candidate' and propose sprint allocation. :thumbsup:

mira (sales): Will do, looping in legal for MSA item.

sam (support): Adding the ticket thread and sample logs to the doc.

elaine (PM): Thanks everyone — marking as triage-> backlog candidate. We'll update stakeholders after design doc review. :eyes:
